villages.traditional_livestock_practices: 5.5 Traditional Knowledge & Customary Practices Surrounding Livestock Keeping Practice Relevance ● Free-Range System ● Chickens are allowed to roam freely, foraging for food and water. ● Traditional Feeding Practices ● Chickens are mostly fed a diet of rice and maize. ● Ethno- Veterinary Practices ● Traditional healers use local herbs like Pine leaves, fishmints, peach to treat chicken ailments. ● Pig Rearing ● Pigs are reared in traditional enclosures, made from bamboo and thatch or tin, timber, cement concrete which results in a low incidence of diseases and clean sty. ● Diet ● Pigs are fed a diet of rice, forest leaves, maize and powdered rice husk. ● Breeding and training ● The local dogs are trained by the villagers for hunting, guarding and companionship. ● Healthcare ● The villagers use local herbs and medicines to treat dog ailments. ● Diet ● Dogs are fed a diet of rice, meat and vegetables. . ● Companionship ● Cats are kept as companions and are often pampered by their owners and are fed with rice, meat and milk. ● Healthcare ● Locals use fermented fish, tinfish and cooked sticky flavored rice to treat cat diseases.

villages.important_water_bodies: 6.6 Detail of Important water bodies/wetlands which is ecological important for village Please mention name, location (image with Geo codes) and why the water body is unique and important. 1. Dzukhaori: The Community Pond This traditional community pond has played a pivotal role in the village's development and daily life. As the village's first water source, it has been a vital component of the community's existence. Historically, the water from this pond was used for various ritual purposes performed by the villagers, underscoring its significance in their spiritual lives. The pond's importance extends beyond its practical uses, as it has become an integral part of the village's cultural heritage. 2. Muzedu: The Natural Salty Spring Well Muzedu, a natural salty spring well, serves as a drinking source for animals. This unique water body is not only a vital resource for the village's fauna but also a fascinating example of the region's geological characteristics. 3. Chokholo Muze: The Mythical Pond Chokholo Muze, a mystical pond, is steeped in local legend. According to tradition, only a fortunate individual from the village can discover the rare and exquisite white Angel trumpet flower, which is said to bloom in this enchanted pond. This myth has contributed to the pond's allure, making it a revered and sought-after destination for villagers and visitors alike.

villages.sacred_groves: Section - 10 Grooves/ Banni/ Sacred groove (Instructions: Gather data for this section along with name of the sacred groove, location including image and any local knowledge and stories about its cultural significance through focus group discussion with a mixed group 1. Rafühao: The Devil's Domain Rafühao, a foreboding area, has long been feared by the locals, who believe it to be a place of dark forces. According to legend, anyone who ventures into this area never returns, leaving behind only whispers of terror and unease. The villagers' deep-seated fear of Rafühao has led to its avoidance, with many considering it a place best left unexplored. 2. Zuvüri River: The Abode of Satan The ancient villagers believed that the Zuvüri River was home to Satan himself, striking fear into the hearts of all who dared to approach its waters. This dark reputation has persisted, with many locals continuing to view the river with a mix of trepidation and awe. 3. Khazi pü ngaonuoze Lake: The Living snake lake The Khazi pü ngaonuoze Lake was once said to be home to a fearsome snake, a creature so terrifying that it was believed to be a ghost. According to local legend, Mamaso (which means ghost in Tsupfume dialect) would often emerge from the depths of the lake to frighten unsuspecting villagers. However, the snake's reign of terror eventually came to an end when brave villagers banded together to kill the beast. With Mamaso vanquished, the lake is now safe for villagers to cross, although the legend of the ghostly snake continues to captivate and unsettle all who hear it. 4. The Wild Apple Tree: A Haunted Legacy A Wild Apple tree stands as a haunting reminder of a tragic event that occurred on March 28, 1968. This area became a source of terror for the villagers, who believed that the ghosts haunt the late comers. However, according to local lore, the ancient villagers eventually managed to vanquish the malevolent spirits, rendering the area safe for future generations to pass throu

Fig: Miracle Cave (Tsudubo) :This Stonehenge was the miraculous work of Khameluo & Motiluo, constructed overnight. This particular place provides shelter for ancient warriors and travelers. It is also said even to this day, that the normal food-rate prepared inside the cave does not give any shortage, rather gets extra surplus after having the food, hence it is believed that the prayer and the blessing of the two legends still does the work with the inmates in the cave. To this day Tsudubo is a tourism hot spot for all ages throughout the year. Fig: This is a gathering place where any kinds of meetings were conducted in the olden days . Fig: Kipratsubu (Merit monolith)-The merit monolith located at Kipra symbolized the richness of the concerned host families who had offered the merit feast for the whole village. This is the place where every male dominant both young and old come to perform rituals to foresee the future outcome of the village at the beginning of the year. Such rituals consists:- 1. Enemy invasion; the ritual is performed to foresee any foes invasion will happen during the year. 2. Hunting: this ritual is performed to predict the outcome of hunting wildlife whether good luck shall prevail over the year. 3. Death & diseases: this ritual is also performed to know the forecast of death rate and disease for the said year. 4. Cultivation & weather: this ritual is also performed to predict the outcome of harvest and calamities. By performing the above rituals, the villagers are able to foresee and know the future outcome during the year.

villages.protected_species: भ \ eS * विभाग-1 परिचय: गाव पर्यावरणीय नोंद वही म्हूणजे काय ? /सदस्यांनी केलेला एक गाव पर्यावरणीय नोंद वही हा समाजाच्या समुदायाच्या, त्याच्या समुदायाकरिता त विविधतेवद्दल दस्तऐवज आहे, जो गावाबद्दलची मौखिक पारंपारिक पर्यावरणीय ज्ञान-प्रणाली आणि पद्धती व स्थानिक पट. करून, ज्ञान बदलांची = 7 ’ पद्धतशीरपणे माहिती मिळवतो. कालांतराने गावात घडलेल्या सामाजिक - पर्यावरणीय बदल सर्वसमाहेशक a सहभागात्मक अंतर्दष्टी आणि माहिती जमा संग्रहित करण्यासाठी/गोळा /हे एक माध्यम /भांडार म्हणून का काम कर खय य हे समुदायाच्या दृष्टिकोनामुळे पर्यावरणीय बदलांचे निरीक्षण आणि नोंद करण्यात समुदायाच्या थेट सहभागास प्रोत्साहन मिळेल. पर्यावरणीय सदस्यांमध्ये पर्यावरणीय अभिमुखता आणि संवेदनशीलता उत्तेजित करण्यासाठी स्प्रिगबोर्ड म्हणून देखील काम करेल. निर्देशकांशी संबंधित समुदायामध्ये सर्वसमावेशक चर्चा सुरू करण्याची संधी देखील यामुळे मिळेल. गावपर्यावरणीय नोंद वही तयार करण्याची गरज का आहे? गावाच्या पर्यावरणीय नोंदणीची स्थापना करण्याचे प्राथमिक उद्दीष्ट म्हणजे मौखिक पारंपारिक पर्यावरणीय ट्ऱ > ज्ञान प्रणाली आणि पद्धती तसेच समृद्ध जैवविविधता आणि गावाच्या इतिहासात घडलेल्या पर्यावरणीय बदलांची नोंद करण्यासाठी समुदायांना सक्रियपणे सामील सहभागी करून घेणे/. याचा एक महत्त्वाचा घटक म्हणजे मौषिक ग्रामीण इतिहासाचे जतन करणे, जे पिढ्यानपिढ्या विणलेल्या गुंतागुंतीच्या पर्यावरणीय रचनेची अतंर्दुष्टी प्रदान करणारे ण्‌क अमूल्य संसाधन म्हणून काम करते. पारंपारिक ज्ञान आणि उपाख्यानांचा समावेश करून, पर्यावरणीय नोंदणी हे केवळ बदलांचे दस्तऐवजीकरण करण्याचेच नव्हे तर कालांतराने गावात सामाजिक आणि पर्यावरणीय बदल कसे घडले आहेत याची सखोल समज माहिती/मिळवण्या चे एक साधन बनते. या व्यतिरिक्त, पर्यावरणीय नोंदणी मुळे पिढ्यानपिढ्या ज्ञानाचे हस्तांतरण सुलभ सोपे/होते, ज्यामुळे पारंपारिक शहाणपर्ण/ज्ञान आणि पद्धती युगानुयुगे पुढे जात असल्याचे सुनिश्चित होते. हे केवळ समुदायाच्या समाजाच्या सांस्कृतिक रचनेला/ समृद्ध करत नाही तर अधिक माहितीपूर्ण आणि शाश्वत पर्यावरणीय पद्धतीं मध्ये देखील योगदान देते. म्हणूनच, हा उपक्रम सामान्य आणि जैवविविधता संवर्धनाबद्दल जागरूकता आणि चर्चांना प्रोत्साहन देण्यासाठी संवर्धन आणि समर्थना भोवती केंद्रित उपक्रमांना चालना देण्
